The Mobi series includes the live chat tool Mobi Agent, the chatbot Mobi Bot, and the voicebot Mobi Voice, and there are also Mūa (MooA), an operations support AI that uses generative AI, and maestra, the AI agent development platform of consolidated subsidiary vottia Inc., among others.
